units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 5:5">Kel. V, 5</cite> <he>מוּסַף התנור</he> a chimney-piece; <he>מ׳ היורה</he> the rim around a boiler in the ground. Ib. 11 <he>מ׳ של טיט</he> a moulding of clay around the stove; <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 4:18">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. IV, 18</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 12:10">Tosef. Par. XII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 11:10">XI</cite>), 10 <he>מ׳ יורה</he>, v. supra.

senses.gloss: (sub. תְּפִלַּת, קָרְבַּן) Musaf, additional offering, additional prayer on Sabbaths and festive (and fast-) days.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 3:10">Tosef. Ber. III, 10</cite> <he>כל שאין בו מ׳</he> a half-festival on which there is no Musaf (prayer or offering); <he>וכל שיש בו מ׳</he> and one on which there is a Musaf; <cite ref="Shabbat 24a:3">Sabb. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>ימים שיש בהן קרבן מ׳</he>.
Ib. כיון דלית ביה מ׳ since there is no Musaf appointed for it; a. fr.—Pl. (with sing. sense) מוּסָפִין.
